natural_body: Deep discounts spike signups +31% but risk renewal. Use tactically with guardrails.

first.rationale: Simplifying onboarding directly addresses the 4% completion decline and is supported by prior durable lifts in completion, time-to-value, and SMB activation. It is preferable to reactive discounting, which carries renewal risk. Run a controlled experiment and evaluate qualified activation and downstream revenue—not completion alone—to ensure simplification does not reduce customer quality.
